Convert dot-bracket structure for plotting

Code 
source("functions/3.spatial_plot.R") # temp

hhrzTheoAptaz_db <- ".(((((((((....((((((.......((((......)))).......(((((.(((((.......))))).))))).))))))....)))))))))."
secondary_structure <- parse_dotbracket(hhrzTheoAptaz_db)

# Add annotations for key positions manually
annotation_df <- bind_rows(
  mutate(secondary_structure, source = "auto"),
  tibble(
    Name = c("Core", "CM1", "CM2", "Aptamer"),
    start = c(21, 49, 73, 53),
    end = c(27, 53, 77, 73),
    colour = c("orange", "blue", "blue", NA),
    source = "manual"
  )
)

Mapping contribution to each nucleotide position

Mapping catalysis scores across the ribozyme sequence

The table below counts substitutions and sums the WT-normalised score changes for each destination nucleotide at each position. Indels are excluded, and a multi-mutant contributes its complete score change to each of its substitutions.

Code 
subset_data <- filter_data(data, 2)$filtered # count >= 2

contribution1 <- make_contribution_table(subset_data)

# plot total_net catalysis across positions
plt_spatial <- 
  plot_contribution_across_sequence(contribution1, "total_net_catalysis_mean")

Show secondary structure with contribution scores

Code 
source("functions/3.spatial_plot.R") # temp

annotated_plt <-
  plt_spatial + annotate_sequence(annotation_df)

annotated_plt
Code 
ggsave(str_c(base_path,"/spatial_plot.png"), annotated_plt, width = 8, height = 6)
